purpose: Annual structural signal study, not mortality prediction or a test of real-life risk.

input.calendar: proleptic Gregorian; no guessed calendar conversions
input.sex: M or F recorded source field, otherwise abstain; no identity inference
input.clock_sensitivity: root prespecified shifts ±30 and ±120 minutes; apparent solar clock is an optional separately labelled scenario if coordinates/instant known

annual_snapshot.age: root computes civil attained age at snapshot; engines also expose their own nominal cycle ages

bazi.season_clock: same birth instant expressed UTC+8 for solar-term year/month and qiyun calculation; local clock only for day/hour
bazi.qiyun: lunar-python Yun sect2 minute-proportional 3 days=1 year; yang male/yin female forward, converse backward; explicit integer minute conversion
bazi.decade_interval: exact first qiyun timestamp then successive ten-calendar-year intervals, not rounded birth-year bins
bazi.primary_score: number of six-clash branch pairs between annual/active decadal pillars and four natal pillars divided by 8; pre-qiyun score unavailable
bazi.secondary: stem controls, stem combinations, six harmonies, six harms, full punishment sets, self punishments, full three-harmony sets, repeated pillars, combined stem-control/branch-clash, twelve growth phases; descriptive support tally only
bazi.strength: visible stems weight1, each branch hidden stems share total weight1; month branch hidden weights doubled; same/resource element fraction. Weak<0.45, balanced[.45,.55], strong>.55 is a research annotation, NOT a canonical wangshuai verdict.
bazi.patterns: month main-hidden-stem ten-god annotation, exposed/rooted features; transformations and yongshen not automatically adjudicated
bazi.rescue: report combination/resource context separately; do not numerically erase a clash or convert into a calibrated favorable/unfavorable outcome
missing_interpretive_modules: full classical rescue and outcome judgment

ziwei.overseas_mapping: source local Gregorian date into Chinese date-to-lunar table, a declared convention, not an authenticated universal traditional mapping
ziwei.primary_score: mean of two indicators: yearly hua-ji natal-star position lies in yearly life/health palaces; decadal hua-ji natal-star position lies in decadal life/health palaces. Both valid scopes required.
ziwei.secondary: all 12 natal palaces, main/minor/decorative stars, brightness, natal four transformations, decadal/yearly palace maps and transformations/transit stars, six-malefic and benefic surroundings, fallen major-star counts, positive transformation context
ziwei.rescue: context counts and positive transformations retained separately; no unsupported net risk score

completeness_rule: Computational pipeline completion must be distinguished from a complete traditional interpretive system; never label these primary structural scores as four full validated prediction systems.

sources.role: Sanming Tonghui luck-period and contextual interpretation text; does not justify this study numeric score
Ziwei natal/decadal/yearly, mutagen, brightness and rescue context; does not define a unique numeric mortality model
